label: Build First 4 Days
assets_help: Attach agenda/welcome pages, images, existing source documents, or other assets only when they help the build. The structured plan above is the primary required input.

plan_fields.label: Resources / counts to build
plan_fields.placeholder: Example: 4 Warm-Ups; short Notes; Practice + Extra Practice; 1 Activity; 1 Investigation; 3 Exit Tickets; overview; survey.

plan_fields.label: Warm-Up topics / skills
plan_fields.placeholder: List by day. Example: Day 1 — multiplying fractions + diamond; Day 2 — one-step equations; ...

plan_fields.label: Notes learning targets / I-can statements
plan_fields.placeholder: Paste or type the opening learning targets/I-cans. Add any special Notes or WTC direction here.

plan_fields.label: Practice / Extra Practice focus
plan_fields.placeholder: Skills/I-cans, approximate question count, special workspace/representation needs, or leave blank if not requested.

plan_fields.label: Activity idea / participation goal
plan_fields.placeholder: What students should practice/do and any activity structure you already have in mind.

plan_fields.label: Investigation / Demo idea
plan_fields.placeholder: Core idea, materials, what students build/measure/observe, and representations or predictions you want.

plan_fields.label: Exit Tickets / portfolio baseline
plan_fields.placeholder: How many exits, what evidence you want, and what should enter the portfolio baseline.

plan_fields.label: Other opening details
plan_fields.placeholder: Day-by-day agenda, naming, overview/survey/welcome details, special assets, constraints, etc.

delivery_note: ZIP may be used for handoff; canonical GitHub storage is expanded.
